sampledSpectrum.source: Gaia Collaboration (2023), Gaia Data Release 3, A&A 674, A1; BP/RP spectra: De Angeli et al. (2023), A&A 674, A2, and externally calibrated sampled spectra: Montegriffo et al. (2023), A&A 674, A3
sampledSpectrum.sampling: 343 samples from 336 to 1020 nm in 2 nm steps, flux in W m^-2 nm^-1 (the DataLink default sampling)
sampledSpectrum.note: Gaia's own low-resolution spectrum of the star, calibrated to absolute flux. Its samples at the even wavelengths from 380 to 780 nm are weighted by the CIE 1931 2-degree observer. The range in the prepared report is the color of the spectrum moved one standard error down and up at every sample.

crossCheck.source: Kiehling (1987), spectrophotometry of 60 bright F, G, K and M stars, 320-880 nm in 1 nm steps as normalised magnitudes: Kiehling (1987), A&AS 69, 465; VizieR III/124. * omi02 Eri is HR 1325.
